lsp.description: TypeScript and JavaScript code intelligence using a Cadencr source build of the native TypeScript Go preview with an upstream shutdown fix backported, and bundled standard libraries.
lsp.name: TypeScript native preview

changelog:
TypeScript native preview package 0.1.1

Minimum Cadencr application version: 0.16.1. This release publishes package assets only. Production marketplace catalog admission, the LSP revocation feed and the desktop release remain separate rollout steps.

This is a Cadencr source build of the upstream TypeScript native preview 7.0.0-dev.20260707.2 (microsoft/typescript-go 9977d6d38fcc78de8ae71770f3aa08256e6cc861) with one backported fix: the server now exits with status 0 after a clean shutdown and exit (microsoft/TypeScript#64742, first commit of microsoft/TypeScript#64894). Declaration libraries, license and notice files are the unmodified npm package files; the applied patch ships in CADENCR-PATCHES/. Microsoft's detached signature of its Linux npm binary (lib/tsgo.sig) is not redistributed because it does not cover the rebuilt executable. The macOS executables are not Microsoft's Developer ID-signed binaries: ARM carries the Go linker's ad hoc signature and Intel is unsigned. Cadencr's signed catalog and pinned hashes attest this distribution, not Microsoft's identity.

Canonical archive and runtime qualification: https://github.com/merkr-software/CadencR/actions/runs/42616915442

Packaged binary deployment floors: macOS ARM 12.0.0, macOS Intel 12.0.0. Runtime qualification used macOS 15 on both architectures and Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 x86_64; older OS runtime certification and application OS support are separate.
